summary: Stoke Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $200 million of common stock through Cantor Fitzgerald. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), replacing a prior ATM supplement. The company already sold 4.7 million shares for $146.4 million under the previous program. No special-situation event is present; this is an ordinary capital-raising current report. There are no deal terms such as a fixed price or premium, and no other strategic action.
